description: Previous-day volume-weighted value migration with two M15 outside closes, session VWAP migration, M5 retest and one value-range extension

cost_assumptions.rationale: Every fill costs 6 bp. Bar-only market entry reserves one tick for the synthetic executable-side crossing and one tick from OneTickSlippageFillModel. Stop execution reserves shifted preceding-hour ten-second true-range Q99. Official funding, mark price and native liquidation remain enabled.
cost_assumptions.actual_funding_settlement: checksum-verified Binance Vision monthly fundingRate archives with native mark-price settlement
cost_assumptions.stop_market_slippage_reserve: shifted Q99 of completed ten-second true range over the preceding sixty minutes, minimum one tick

scenario_contract.market_mechanism: A completed UTC day defines a volume-weighted fair-value distribution. A major session migrates value only when two consecutive completed M15 closes remain outside one one-sigma value edge, the cumulative session VWAP is also outside that edge, and a later separate M5 retest touches and holds the accepted boundary.
scenario_contract.previous_day_profile: Exactly 288 contiguous completed M5 bars from the prior UTC day. Typical price is weighted by completed bar volume. VWAP plus/minus one weighted standard deviation defines value low and value high.

sessions.LONDON: 08:00 Europe/London converted to UTC for each local date
sessions.NEW_YORK: 09:30 America/New_York converted to UTC for each local date

scenario_contract.first_close: First directional M15 close at least 0.05 previous-day sigma outside one completed value edge.
scenario_contract.acceptance: The immediately following contiguous completed M15 bar also closes outside the same edge and cumulative session VWAP is outside that edge.
scenario_contract.retest: A later separate completed M5 bar touches the accepted value edge within 0.05 completed M5 ATR and closes outside. Re-entry through the edge terminates the attempt.
scenario_contract.entry: First contiguous completed ten-second execution observation after the M5 retest. Ten-second data does not choose direction, session, setup quality, stop or target.
scenario_contract.stop: Beyond the most adverse accepted-edge/retest/execution sequence extreme plus 0.05 retest-bar ATR, at least 0.10 ATR from entry.
scenario_contract.target: Exactly one completed previous-day value-range width beyond the accepted edge, frozen before the session and rejected if consumed before order submission.
scenario_contract.one_attempt: At most the first value-migration attempt per session is eligible; failed or uneconomic attempts are not retried.
